content:
[V] low | top-right header | "3 organizations" label floats without container and duplicates the footer count
[L] med | table right column | Delete buttons crowd and nearly touch adjacent Open/Edit buttons, creating a cramped action cluster
[S] low | table | numeric columns (CUSTOMERS, CONVERSATIONS) right-align values but headers are left-aligned, misaligning header/value pairs
[H] low | new organization form | "Name"/"Domains" labels and inputs sit on opposite ends of a very wide row, breaking label-field association
[H] med | footer | "3 organizations · Open shows members..." debug-style hint string is low-value filler competing with real content
[C] high | bottom half of screen | roughly 40% of the viewport below the footer is empty unmanaged dead zone
[C] med | new organization form | form inputs confined to right edge while left half is empty, content floats without structure
[S] low | header area | "Sync now" button baseline sits higher than "3 organizations" text, uneven vertical alignment
[S] low | new organization form | uneven vertical gaps between Name row, Domains row, and Create button (button gap larger than field gaps)
[V] low | domains column | monospace font for domain values differs from sans-serif used elsewhere, inconsistent type treatment
